notes.title: ⨁My Cute PAGANGIRL⨁ is here!
notes.content:
[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steam/apps/1631860/extras/storebannertop1BIGgif_1100.gif?t=1626957868[/img]

[h1]ːCatsHeartː[b]Hi there, kitties![/b] ːCatsHeartː[/h1]

[b]⨁My Cute Pagangirl⨁[/b] has finally released!ːfuhrer_heartː

Set off into a captivating journey in [b]Magna Germania[/b] and spend your hot summer holiday with cute pagan anime girls Will you be able to reveal the truth of the disappearing people in lush German forests and melt the frozen heart of a ruthless Head of the ancient [b]Germanic matriarchal tribe[/b]? The course of the story depends only on you! Each choice you make is important and affects the story!ːlit_prosecː

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1631860/My_Cute_Pagangirl/

This game introduces you to the [b]dark pagan mythology[/b] of the ancient [b]Slavic and Germanic tribes[/b]. Find out the truth behind the people disappearing and reveal the one who’s responsible for the desecration of the ancient pagan obelisks. And, of course, chat with cute anime girls.ːfuhrer_teaː

ːblue_heartːWe want to thank everyone who follows our games and gives us their feedback. We truly appreciate itːblue_heartː

[h1][b]Check out this free DLC![/b][/h1]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1688000/My_Cute_Pagangirl__FREE_Girls_pack/
